why_it_matters.text: A dopamine agonist sold as Requip, used for Parkinson's disease and restless legs syndrome. It mimics dopamine at the D2 and D3 receptors.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under ANDA 078110 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
